parameters.description: Optional header that allows parent merchant to consume the API on behalf of sub-merchant.

parameters.name: authorization
parameters.description: Customers can generate JWT using our Auth API with various grant types in the request body. JWT is valid for 15minutes.

reference_id.description: A specific unique ID assigned by you for this transaction. If not kept unique, transaction status extraction could behave erratically.

consumer_urn.description: A unique identifier provided by Decentro at the time of onboarding

frequency.description: Frequency of the debits (Onetime, Monthly, Weekly, Daily, Quarterly, Bimonthly, Fortnightly, Halfyearly, Yearly, Aspresented)

purpose_message.description: The narration that you want to show as a message for the mandate registration.

rule_type.description: Type of Rule (ON / BEFORE / AFTER). If frequency is other than ONETIME/AS PRESENTED/DAILY, then rule_type is mandatory

amount_rule.description: Mandate amount rule: (MAX or FIXED) MAX: Maximum amount FIXED: Exact amount

start_date.description: Mandate start date. Needs to be on and after the date when the API is triggered.

end_date.description: Mandate end date. Needs to be after the date when the API is triggered. Max tenure is 30 years

expiry_time.description: Expiry Time of the mandate within 24 hrs and data to be provided in Minutes. Min: 1. Max: 1440

default_amount.description: The default amount to be used for presentation. Mandatory if amount_rule = MAX

is_downpayment.description: To enable any instant presentation, pass this flag as True; Else pass as False. Amount will be deducted immediately after mandate registration. is_downpayment flag & is_first_txn_amount flag can't set as true at a same time.

is_first_txn_amount.description: If set to true, the mandate will be treated as a First Amount Mandate. Only supported for QR/Intent-based Autopay flows. In FAM, the amount rule type must be set to MAX. is_downpayment flag & is_first_txn_amount flag can't set as true at a same time.

generate_psp_uri.description: true/ false depending on the choice to generate UPI mandate URI/intent flow to implement customized flow based on URI data.

is_managed_by_decentro.description: This param is used to identify if the mandate is managed by Decentro. Accepted values true or false.

is_qr_requested.description: This flag is used to identify whether the QR code is requested. Pass true for QR code and false for no QR code.

is_block_funds.description: This flag is used to block funds in the user's bank account. This feature is available only for one-time mandates and lending MCCs. Accepted values are "true" to block funds, and "false" to not block funds.

is_revokable.description: This flag is used to set non-revokable mandates. It is available only for IPO and Lending MCCs. Accepted values are: "true" – the user can revoke the mandate, "false" – the mandate cannot be revoked by the user.

is_collect_request.description: This flag is used to identify whether the merchant is initiating the collect request or intent link. Pass true for collect requests and false for intent. Supported MCCs 6012 & 6211.

is_tpv.description: This flag is used to identify whether the collect request requires third-party validation. TPV will only work for collect requests.

payer_details.description: This object is required only if "is_collect_request" is set to true.

account_no.description: This is required only if the "is_tpv" flag is set to true. The payer can register the mandates only from the above-mentioned bank account number.

mandate_action_callback_subscriber_data.description: Custom endpoint for sharing the Mandate Status Callback. This will override the default callback endpoints configured for your account.

url.description: The callback URL to receive the latest mandate status updates.

content-type.description: The header content required for posting the callback

redirect_url.description: This is a optional parameter. Merchants can pass the redirection URL. Max support of characters are 2048. Only "https://" endpoints will be accepted.

mutual_funds_order.description: This is an array of objects. Multiple mutual funds details can be passed here

downpayment_reference_id.description: This reference_id will be used to initiate the instant presentations(5mins presentations). Value will be passed only if is_downpayment flag is set as true

first_txn_amount_reference_id.description: This reference_id will be used to initiate the instant presentations(5mins presentations). Value will be passed only if is_first_txn_amount flag is set as true
